purpose: Fieldset-based radio group with label, description, error, orientation, disabled, required, controlled, and uncontrolled state.

guidance.useWhen: Use for mutually exclusive choice sets in forms and settings.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid for long option lists; use Select instead.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Prefer RadioGroup over hand-built radio collections.

limitations: Avoid for long option lists; use Select instead.

accessibility.notes: Uses fieldset/legend and native radio keyboard behavior.
